cards.title: Words from a dictionary factory
cards.text: A page's words keyed by an enum of its parts, never a list of string literals.

cards.title: An enum of the parts
cards.text: One enum per list, in a Parts/ folder beside the content, its order the page's.

cards.title: Every key has its words
cards.text: A switch arm per part; a part without words stops the class loading.

cards.title: A framework function
cards.text: In LouisAgent.Composition, so any page, pack or host can use it.

cards.title: Converted when touched
cards.text: A step that changes a page's content leaves it on a factory.
